mapsHelp: Upload OCAD maps once for the club. When you set up an event, pick a map from this list — Oxygen copies it into the event.
dropMapHere: Drop an OCAD map file (.ocd) here
emptyMaps: No maps in the library yet.
deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be removed from the library. Events that already copied it keep their own map.
pickerEmpty: The club library has no maps yet. Upload one from Club library first.
controlsHelp: Define the club's punching units as series. Own units first, borrowed ranges after — the course editor allocates codes in that order. Mark SRR units so placed controls are radio-ready.
emptySeries: No control series yet. Add the club's own units first.
deleteSeriesBody: "{{name}}" and all of its codes will be removed. Events that already used those codes keep their controls.
addResult: Added {{added}}, skipped {{skipped}} already in the series
classesHelp: Define the club's recurring class catalogue. Events copy selected presets; later preset changes do not alter existing event classes.
deleteClassPresetBody: Delete class preset "{{name}}"? Event classes already created from it are unchanged.
groupsHelp: Club groups are named sets of users. Grant an event role to a whole group at once — membership changes apply immediately to every event the group has a role on. Only instance admins can edit groups.
groupsReadOnly: Only instance admins can create or edit groups.
deleteGroupBody: "{{name}}" will be removed, along with every event role it has been granted. Members lose those permissions immediately.
